description: End-to-end human task-space fidelity of the final safety-projected command and measured free-base MuJoCo qpos; raw IK is not reported.

measurement_contract.safe_command: last motor target applied after standing balance and support FSM during each input frame
measurement_contract.actual_qpos: measured canonical joint qpos after the last MuJoCo step driven by that same input frame
measurement_contract.frame_alignment: MediaPipePoseLandmarker.estimate starts a frame; the next estimate closes it, retaining the final apply/step pair
measurement_contract.unilateral_leg_semantics: production calibrated/debounced lift intent matched FIFO to the support FSM side and measured safe/actual foot clearance
measurement_contract.task_acceptance: only the semantic directions, event sides, and p90 groups predeclared by each canonical task contract affect task passage
measurement_contract.whole_body_fidelity: all anatomical groups remain reported; non-task and unsupported channels are descriptive limitations/warnings and never silently become acceptance gates

threshold_policy.rationale: Directional p90 limits stay materially below orthogonal tracking; semantic motion must reproduce at least 20-25% of human amplitude, show positive moderate correlation, and follow within 0.5 s. The correlation search extends beyond that gate so late tracking can fail rather than win at the search boundary. Calibrated unilateral leg clips instead use FIFO intent/FSM/clearance events because monocular depth is not an independent leg-direction oracle. Every declared task must pass, while coverage and sample-count gates apply only to its predeclared acceptance channels/groups. Limits and task contracts were declared independently of a generated result artifact.

task_contracts.task_label: alternating unilateral balance with arm motion
task_contracts.capability: contact-gated left/right leg lift plus bounded arm imitation
unsupported_limitations: monocular 3-D leg depth is descriptive; calibrated image-plane intent and physical foot clearance define lift acceptance

task_contracts.capability: bounded full-body imitation while preserving bilateral ground contact
unsupported_limitations: flight and ballistic jumping are unsupported; required leg channels measure the supported grounded projection and remain acceptance gates

task_contracts.capability: contact-gated right leg lift with physical foot clearance
unsupported_limitations: monocular 3-D leg direction is descriptive; calibrated image-plane intent and physical foot clearance define task acceptance

task_contracts.capability: head orientation tracks the observable upper-body orientation proxy
unsupported_limitations: true trunk articulation is unsupported because the robot has no waist DOF
torso-relative human leg-direction rotation is descriptive and is not interpreted as requested leg articulation while both feet stay planted
